new.s: In which district of Gujarat is the Statue of Unity located?
new.x: The Statue of Unity stands on Sadhu Bet island at Ekta Nagar (Kevadia) in Narmada district, facing the Sardar Sarovar Dam.
new.angle: U0247 notes gap: Statue of Unity -> Narmada district

new.s: Where was Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel born on 31 October 1875?
new.x: Patel was born at Nadiad on 31 October 1875; this date is observed as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas.
new.angle: U0247 notes gap: Patel's birthplace Nadiad

new.s: On which date is Civil Services Day observed in India?
new.x: Civil Services Day (21 April) marks Patel's address to the first IAS probationers at Metcalfe House, Delhi, on 21 April 1947.
new.angle: U0247 notes gap: Civil Services Day 21 April

new.s: Who among the following was the Chairman of the Provincial Constitution Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
new.x: Patel chaired the Provincial Constitution Committee and the Advisory Committee; Nehru chaired the Union Powers and Union Constitution Committees.
new.angle: U0247 notes gap: Provincial Constitution Committee -> Patel

new.s: Who presided over the first session of the All India States Peoples' Conference (1927)?
new.x: The AISPC was founded at Bombay in December 1927; its first session was presided over by Diwan Bahadur Ramachandra Rao.
new.angle: U0248 notes gap: AISPC first session -> Ramachandra Rao

new.s: Where was the All India States Peoples' Conference founded in 1927?

new.s: With which region is Vijay Singh Pathik associated in the States' People's movement?

new.s: In which year was the All India States Peoples' Conference dissolved and its units merged into the Congress?

new.s: Who was the Nawab of Junagadh when the state announced its accession to Pakistan in 1947?

new.s: The 'Arzi Hukumat' (provisional government) of 1947 is associated with which princely state?

new.angle: U0248 notes gap: Arzi Hukumat -> Junagadh

new.s: In which month and year did Manipur and Tripura merge with India?
new.x: Manipur and Tripura merged with India through merger agreements in October 1949.

new.x: The Delhi Agreement on Jammu and Kashmir was concluded in 1952.

new.s: Who became the Military Governor of Hyderabad after Operation Polo?
new.x: Maj. Gen. J.N. Chaudhuri, who commanded the Indian forces in Operation Polo, became Military Governor of Hyderabad.
new.angle: U0248 notes gap: Military Governor -> J.N. Chaudhuri

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Hyderabad after Operation Polo:
1. Maj. Gen. J.N. Chaudhuri became its Military Governor.
2. As a Part B state, it had the Nizam as its Rajpramukh.
3. M.K. Vellodi was its first elected Chief Minister.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Chaudhuri was Military Governor and the Nizam became Rajpramukh; Vellodi was the first civilian CM (1950), while Burgula Ramakrishna Rao was the first elected CM (1952).

new.s: Who was the Rajpramukh of Hyderabad State when it was a Part B state (1950-56)?

new.angle: U0248 notes gap: Nizam as Rajpramukh

new.s: To which state were the Raichur and Gulbarga districts of Hyderabad State transferred in 1956?
new.x: On the dissolution of Hyderabad State, Telugu districts went to Andhra Pradesh, Marathwada to Bombay State and Raichur and Gulbarga to Mysore.
new.angle: U0248 notes gap: Raichur, Gulbarga -> Mysore

new.s: On which date was Hyderabad State dissolved under the States Reorganisation?
new.x: Hyderabad State was dissolved on 1 November 1956 and its regions were shared among Andhra Pradesh, Bombay and Mysore.
new.angle: U0248 notes gap: Hyderabad dissolved 1 Nov 1956

new.s: Who was the first Chief Minister of Andhra State (1953)?

new.s: At which place was the October 1954 referendum held that led to the transfer of the French settlements to India?
new.x: After the Kizhur referendum of October 1954, Pondicherry, Karikal, Mahe and Yanam passed to India de facto on 1 November 1954.
new.angle: U0248 notes gap: Kizhur referendum

new.s: On which date did the French settlements of Pondicherry, Karikal, Mahe and Yanam pass to India de jure?
new.x: They passed de facto on 1 November 1954 and de jure on 16 August 1962.
new.angle: U0248 notes gap: French enclaves de jure 1962

new.s: On whose birthday is National Education Day observed on 11 November?
new.x: National Education Day (11 November) marks the birthday of Maulana Azad, independent India's first Education Minister.

new.s: Where was 'Rashid Ali Day' observed on 11 February 1946?

new.angle: U0249 notes gap: Rashid Ali Day -> Calcutta

new.s: What was the total strength of the Constituent Assembly under the Cabinet Mission Plan?

new.angle: U0249 notes gap: Constituent Assembly strength 389

new.s: When did the Cabinet Mission arrive in India?
new.x: The Mission's dispatch was announced on 19 February 1946; it arrived on 24 March 1946 and announced its plan on 16 May 1946.
new.angle: U0249 notes gap: Cabinet Mission arrival 24 March 1946

new.x: The Cabinet Mission was sent by Prime Minister Clement Attlee.
new.angle: U0249 notes gap: Cabinet Mission sent by Attlee

new.s: On which date was the Indian Independence Bill introduced in the British House of Commons?
new.x: The Bill was introduced on 4 July 1947, received royal assent on 18 July and came into effect on 15 August 1947.

new.s: Who introduced the Indian Independence Bill in the House of Commons in July 1947?

new.s: When did Lord Mountbatten take charge as Viceroy of India?
